credits.title: Pimp City: A Journey to the Center of the Sex Slave Trade
credits.overview: Journalist Mariana van Zeller investigates sex trafficking between Tenancingo, Mexico, and Queens, New York. Through interviews with survivors, traffickers and law enforcement officials, the documentary examines the networks that exploit women and transport them across the border into forced prostitution.
